block.arcane.arcane_workbench.desc:
A scribe's desk where glyphs become spells.
Glyph order changes the outcome.
block.arcane.mana_crystal.desc:
Pulses with raw mana. Magic grows stronger nearby,
but long exposure is poisonous.
item.arcane.arcane_pen.desc:
Writes the active spell onto blocks and chests.
Ink in the other hand. Sneak to erase.
item.arcane.common_ink.desc: Stable ink with no side effects.
item.arcane.blood_ink.desc:
Lowers the spell's mana cost,
but drains the writer's health.
item.arcane.invisible_ink.desc:
Inscriptions other mages
struggle to see.
item.arcane.arcane_mask.desc:
Filters mana from the air.
Reduces Mana Poisoning by 30%.
item.arcane.insulating_cloak.desc:
Cloth that does not conduct mana.
Reduces Mana Poisoning by 40%.
item.arcane.glyph_projector.desc: Right-click: projects a hologram of the active spell. Sneak: analyzes the nearest magical residue.
item.arcane.symmetry_mirror.desc: Right-click an Arcane Altar to complete the circle by copying symmetric traces.

Your spells, glyphs and discoveries.

Right-click: adds 2 pages to your grimoire

The heart of the ritual. Right-click: casts the active spell with the circle's power.
Shift + right-click: stores the spell (the Activate glyph triggers it).

Draws ritual traces on the ground, one by one.
For big circles, use the Arcane Compass.
item.arcane.arcane_compass.desc:
Right-click an Altar: draws the ritual circle around it (uses ink).
Shift + right-click: changes the size (radius 4, 8 or 16).
tutorial.arcane.title: Arcane Guide
tutorial.arcane.page1:
ARCANE GUIDE

Magic here is a language: glyphs in order form a sentence. The same sequence always does the same thing.

You win by learning, not by bigger numbers.
tutorial.arcane.page2:
1. WORKBENCH

Place the Arcane Workbench and right-click it. Pick glyphs in order, name the spell and save. On the bench a spell has 100% power; in the field, 30%.
tutorial.arcane.page3:
2. GRIMOIRE

Press G to open the grimoire. V casts the active spell, B switches spells. The grimoire floats beside you and ALWAYS drops when you die, with everything inside.
tutorial.arcane.page4:
3. FINDING GLYPHS

Watch mages cast, find glyph notes in structure chests, study scrolls. The more you use a glyph, the better you master it.
tutorial.arcane.page5:
4. ELEMENTS

Storm is stronger in the rain. Fire fails in water. Frost puts out the target's fire. Venom thrives in swamps. Read the terrain before you fight.
tutorial.arcane.page6:
5. RITUALS

Place the Arcane Altar and draw a circle with chalk or the Compass. The bigger the circle, the more power and area. Spells with ritual glyphs only work there.

glyph.arcane.self.desc: Form: the spell happens on you.
glyph.arcane.touch.desc: Form: affects whatever you aim at, up close (3 blocks).
glyph.arcane.projectile.desc: Form: fires an orb that applies the spell where it lands (creature or block).
glyph.arcane.ray.desc: Form: an instant beam that hits the first creature or block you aim at.
glyph.arcane.aura.desc: Form: affects every creature around you (except you).
glyph.arcane.damage.desc: Effect: hurts the target. The creature will turn on you.
glyph.arcane.fire.desc: Effect: sets creatures ablaze. Does nothing to blocks (use Ignite).
glyph.arcane.push.desc: Effect: knocks the target away from you. On yourself, it is a forward dash.
glyph.arcane.slow.desc: Effect: the target moves slowly for a while.
glyph.arcane.poison.desc: Effect: poisons the target, wearing it down (never kills).
glyph.arcane.speed.desc: Effect: the target runs faster for a while.
glyph.arcane.levitate.desc: Effect: the target floats upward for a few seconds.
glyph.arcane.shield.desc: Effect: grants absorption hearts to the target.
glyph.arcane.thunder.desc: Effect: a lightning bolt strikes the target. Beware of the fire.
glyph.arcane.explode.desc: Effect: explodes at the target without breaking blocks. Hurts everyone nearby, you included.
glyph.arcane.blink.desc: Effect: you teleport to the spot you are aiming at.
glyph.arcane.ignite.desc: Effect: lights a fire on the target block, if there is free space above.
glyph.arcane.dig.desc: Effect: breaks the target block if it is soft (dirt, sand, wood, plain stone). Never breaks chests.
glyph.arcane.self_filter.desc: Filter: restricts the effect to you.
glyph.arcane.blocks.desc: Filter: targets blocks instead of creatures.
glyph.arcane.undead.desc: Filter: only affects the undead (zombies, skeletons...).
glyph.arcane.not_self.desc: Filter: removes you from the targets.
glyph.arcane.nearest.desc: Filter: only the creature closest to you.
glyph.arcane.wounded.desc: Filter: only creatures below half health.
glyph.arcane.area.desc: Modifier: doubles the radius of the form and effect (Aura, Explosion).
glyph.arcane.more_range.desc: Modifier: increases the form's range by 50% (Touch, Ray, Blink).
glyph.arcane.delay.desc: Modifier: what follows only happens a few seconds later.
glyph.arcane.power.desc: Modifier: +50% strength on the previous effect (damage, heal, push, level).
glyph.arcane.lengthen.desc: Modifier: doubles the previous effect's time (fire, slow, poison...).
glyph.arcane.on_hit_entity.desc: Condition: what follows only happens when a creature is hit.
glyph.arcane.on_hit_block.desc: Condition: what follows only happens when a block is hit.
glyph.arcane.after_seconds.desc: Condition: what follows only happens after a few seconds.
glyph.arcane.low_health.desc: Condition: what follows only happens if you are below half health.
glyph.arcane.sneaking.desc: Condition: what follows only happens while you are sneaking.
glyph.arcane.night.desc: Condition: what follows only happens at night.
glyph.arcane.in_water.desc: Condition: what follows only happens while you are in water.
glyph.arcane.activate.desc: Activator: triggers a stored ritual (rituals are not available yet).
glyph.arcane.wave.desc: Form: a cone-shaped wave in front of you, affecting every creature it reaches.
glyph.arcane.pillar.desc: Form: a vertical column at the point you aim at (creatures and the block hit).
glyph.arcane.barrier.desc: Form: raises a 3x3 wall of energy in front of you that fades on its own.
glyph.arcane.mark.desc: Effect: marks the target (it glows). The Marked can be picked later with the Marked filter.
glyph.arcane.gravity.desc: Effect: the target gets heavy and is slammed down (hard landing). Drops sand, gravel and anvils. Several Gravity glyphs add up.
glyph.arcane.attract.desc: Effect: pulls the target toward you.
glyph.arcane.blind.desc: Effect: the target is blinded for a while.
glyph.arcane.wither.desc: Effect: the target withers (continuous Wither damage).
glyph.arcane.invisible.desc: Effect: the target turns invisible for a while.
glyph.arcane.cut.desc: Effect: physical damage (armor reduces it). Shears sheep and, on blocks, instantly cuts leaves.
glyph.arcane.freeze.desc: Effect: freezes creatures (slowness and cold) and, on blocks, turns water to ice and lava to obsidian.
glyph.arcane.marked.desc: Filter: only creatures that have been Marked.
glyph.arcane.unmarked.desc: Filter: only creatures that have NOT been Marked.
glyph.arcane.allies.desc: Filter: players, tamed animals, villagers and iron golems.
glyph.arcane.wood.desc: Filter: only wooden blocks (logs and planks).
glyph.arcane.group.desc: Modifier: opens a group. A modifier after End Group affects every effect in the group.
glyph.arcane.end_group.desc: Modifier: closes the group opened by Group.
glyph.arcane.weaken.desc: Modifier: half the strength of the previous effect (damage, heal, push, level). Makes the spell cheaper.
glyph.arcane.repeat.desc: Modifier: repeats the previous effect (the parameter is the total number of times). Each repeat costs the effect again.
glyph.arcane.on_hurt.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows only happens when you take damage (once, for up to 60 s).
glyph.arcane.low_mana.desc: Condition: what follows only happens if your mana is below 20%.
glyph.arcane.standing_still.desc: Condition: what follows only happens while you stand still on the ground.
glyph.arcane.summon_wolves.desc: RITUAL form (minor): summons tamed wolves that fight for you for a while. The wolves are the targets of what follows.
glyph.arcane.summon_golem.desc: RITUAL form (medium): raises an iron golem that guards you for a while. The golem is the target of what follows.
glyph.arcane.warp.desc: RITUAL effect (major): moves every targeted creature to the point you aim at (up to 48). With Aura or Pillar and a big circle, it displaces a whole region.
glyph.arcane.weather.desc: RITUAL effect (legendary): changes the world's weather (0 clear, 1 rain, 2 storm). Requires a Nether Star offering in the major circle.
glyph.arcane.vow_stillness.desc: Customizable vow (Pledge 1-5): bonus = 28% x pledge^0.85 (pledge 2 = +50%). Requires standing still on the ground for (pledge-1) x 1 s before casting.
glyph.arcane.vow_blood.desc: Customizable vow (Pledge 1-5): bonus = 30% x pledge^0.85 (pledge 2 = +54%). Costs 2 x pledge health and refuses if too little is left.
glyph.arcane.vow_daylight.desc: Customizable vow (Pledge 1-5): bonus = 25% x pledge^0.85 (pledge 2 = +45%). 1 day; 2 open sky; 3 no rain; 4 morning to afternoon; 5 near noon.
glyph.arcane.vow_oath.desc: You choose the penalty and how long it lasts, AFTER casting. Kind: 1 immobile, 2 silence (no other spell), 3 sealed mana, 4 fragile (+50% damage taken), 5 blind. Bonus = k x ln(1 + seconds/5), with k 0.30 / 0.22 / 0.35 / 0.25 / 0.20, capped at +150%. E.g. immobile for 30 s = +58%.
glyph.arcane.on_death.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows only happens when you die (once, for up to 60 s).
gui.arcane.param_hint2: Ctrl + mouse wheel adjusts the 2nd parameter (Shift: x5)
